annotations.title: Get NY LLC Publication Pricing by County

description: Returns LLC Publishers' all-inclusive price for New York LLC publication in a county, or for two counties side by side. The price is one fixed, one-time total determined by the county listed in the LLC's Articles of Organization, and it covers publication in both newspapers, the affidavits and the $50 state filing fee. Prices vary by county because newspaper advertising rates differ. Accepts borough names such as Manhattan or Brooklyn. Do NOT use for requirements (use llc_publication_check_requirements), newspaper names or clerk contacts (use llc_publication_get_county_info), or process steps (use llc_publication_get_process_guide).

compare_to.description: Optional second county to compare pricing against

county.description: NY county name for pricing (e.g. 'New York', 'Kings', 'Queens', 'Albany'). Also accepts borough names like 'Manhattan' or 'Brooklyn'.
